Function: extern Indicates that the method is implemented externally (e.g., in another assembly). false Represents the Boolean value false. finally Declares a block of code that will execute after try and catch blocks, regardless of whether an exception was thrown. fixed Pins a variable in place so that it can be accessed by pointer operations without being moved by garbage collection. float Represents a single-precision floating-point number. for Initiates a for loop, which executes statements repeatedly based on specified conditions. foreach Iterates through each element in a collection or array. goto Transfers control to another part of the program, identified by a label. if Executes statements based on whether a specified condition evaluates to true or false. implicit Indicates that a conversion operator can be invoked without an explicit cast. in Used in foreach loops and specifies input parameters in method signatures (in parameter). int Represents a signed 32-bit integer type. interface Declares an interface, which is a contract that classes can implement. internal Specifies that access is limited to the current assembly. is Checks if an object is compatible with a given type and performs casting if it is compatible. lock Acquires the mutual-exclusion lock for a specified object, preventing other threads from accessing it until released. long Represents a signed 64-bit integer type. namespace Declares a scope that contains a set of related objects, such as classes and interfaces. new Creates objects or hides members inherited from base classes; also used to declare constructors. null Represents the absence of any object or value; it is not initialized yet. object The base type from which all other types derive; represents any data type in C#. operator Defines user-defined operators for custom types or overloads existing operators for types defined by the user. out Indicates that an argument is passed by reference and will be initialized within the called method. override Modifies the implementation of an inherited member from the base class. params Allows you to specify a variable number of arguments for methods. private Restricts access to members within the containing class only. protected Restricts access to members within derived classes and containing classes. public Allows access to members from any other code. readonly Indicates that fields can only be assigned during declaration or within constructors. ref Indicates that an argument is passed by reference. return Exits from the current method and optionally returns a value. sbyte Represents an 8-bit signed integer. sealed Prevents other classes from inheriting from it. short Represents a signed 16-bit integer. sizeof Returns the size in bytes of any data type.
